issues.description: Bookstore initializer signature is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement requires a parameterized initializer init(books: [Book]) (problem_statement.md lines 9-12). The solution implementation declares init() (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift lines 14-16) and attempts to assign self.books = books using an undefined variable. Meanwhile the solution's Client constructs a Bookstore with Bookstore(books: books) (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 57). This mismatch prevents the code from compiling and will confuse students about the expected constructor signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Bookstore initializer in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift to match the specification and usage: declare `init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books }`. Also update the template file if it contains an example initializer so the template, solution, and problem statement all use the same parameterized initializer.
